title: MOTOR LEARNING & SKILL ACQUISITION
description: Explores factors influencing how humans learn and acquire motor skills across the lifespan. Emphasizes the application of the theoretical concepts to instructional, clinical, and practical settings.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:50am in LINC 302 - Learning Innovation Center 302 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
